Container.Name: nullInvoice
Container.Overview:
Automated invoice generation with customizable HTML templates for webstores and SaaS integration.
For the full documentation of this project, available in six languages, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/nullInvoice/

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Your UTC TZ offset for database timestamp recording. List of available TZs: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

Config.Name: DB_HOST
Config.Description: Your MariaDB/MySQL database host or container name

Config.Name: DB_USER
Config.Description: The designated user for this application in the database. For more info on the requirements, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/nullInvoice/blob/main/docs/extended/DEPLOYMENT.md#database-setup

Config.Name: DB_NAME
Config.Description: Your MariaDB/MySQL database name. For more info on the requirements, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/nullInvoice/blob/main/docs/extended/DEPLOYMENT.md#database-setup

Config.Name: DB_PARAMS
Config.Description: Additional database connection string parameters. Make sure to set a value for serverTimezone matching your TZ variable setting.

Config.Name: QUEUE_ENABLED
Config.Description: Master switch for the async invoice generation worker. Set to false to disable the background poller. Default: true.
